facts.text: Lyon College celebrates its Scottish heritage with a Scottish arts bagpipe minor, credit courses in Highland dance and drumming, and Scottish Heritage scholarships for pipers, drummers, and dancers.

sources.title: The Scottish Heritage Program - Lyon College catalog
sources.quote: In addition to an international prize-winning pipe band, Lyon's Scottish heritage is promoted through a Scottish arts bagpipe minor, college credit courses in Highland dance and drumming, and an instructional outreach program.

sources.title: The Scottish Heritage Program - Lyon College catalog
sources.quote: The College offers Scottish Heritage scholarships to pipers, drummers, and dancers, within a range of skill levels.
